name: rust-coverage
//: The Rust line floor, enforced once over the union of every Rust crate's instrumented `test` run (each leaves target/coverage/<crate>.lcov). Selected through its inputs whenever Rust source or a Rust test changes, never through graph edges, so it depends on no e2e project. Skipped on Windows, where llvm-cov does not attribute subprocess-spawned binary coverage.

commands: node scripts/rust-coverage.mjs oneharness-core oneharness oneharness-integration oneharness-mock-harness oneharness-e2e oneharness-history-compat oneharness-sdk-contract oneharness-sdk-conformance
